stature.basis: No likeness of him exists: his son told Draper in 1868 'There is no likeness extant of Maj. Heald.' None is in Kirkland (1893), Currey (1912), Quaife (1913) or Andreas (1884), and none was found on Wikipedia or Commons (2026-11-08). So his colouring is from his New Hampshire family of English descent and his height near the period's mean (68.1 in, T-3491). The 1893 photograph of his son Darius with the relics shows the son, not him.
